notes.title: More time is needed to complete the development of version 1.0.
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42289403/f0f8d695335e36008f5ce308c4403b3314ef7b51.png[/img]
Hello everyone,

Thank you for your patience as I work on developing version 1.0 of the game. However, I'm sorry to inform you that the release will be delayed. I initially estimated it would take about 3-4 months, but the scope of work has proven to be quite large for a one-person team. In particular, the new map still doesn’t meet the quality I envisioned, and the Endless mode is also not yet complete.

As I’m committed to maintaining the game’s quality standards, I’ll likely need at least several more months to finish.

Thank you for your understanding and continued support!

Best regards,
Development team

notes.title: 1.0 Release Schedule
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42289403/f0f8d695335e36008f5ce308c4403b3314ef7b51.png[/img]
Hello everyone,

We're very sorry for our lack of communication and updates recently!

We would like to be transparent with you that unfortunately, our studio has suffered a great loss in human resources, which significantly slows down our development speed. At this point, we have decided that instead of releasing small updates for the game, we will release a big update that includes all the content we are working on for the 1.0 release so that the 1.0 release can be as content-rich as possible.

We will try our best to complete and release our 1.0 version by early next year.

We're very grateful for your patience and continued support!

Best regards,
Development team

notes.title: Early Access 1.0.7 New Character Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42289403/ad530cd6e1cac5816ebfe30b42cdfbcf952da9c3.png[/img]
Hello gamers!

We're pleased to announce the Early Access 1.0.7 character update! This update includes:
[list]
[*] A new character Minos with her fun and destructive abilities.
[*] Minos' weapon - the bull cannon, and its 2 evolved forms.
[*] A new passive in-game item.
[*] A new type of trap was added to level 3.
[/list]

We would like to confirm that Minos will have 2 sex scenes in our game. But due to the difficulty of finding a good voice actress, we will have to wait and release her sex scenes in a future update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42289403/101bb87c0b17edfc14f0064924cbeaa6961957c6.gif[/img]
We hope you will have some explosive fun with Minos!

Minos is a collaborative character from another game by our publisher. If you want to see more of her, head over to their store page. https://store.steampowered.com/app/2143540/Isekai_Janken_Hero/

As mentioned in a previous announcement, we're working in parallel on other updates, such as a new level, new game mode, and companions, and we will send out new updates as soon as they are completed!

Best,
FTS team

notes.title: Early Access 1.0.5 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42321748/1b42079f9e97b31d6baf26e11c16d3821fdd774c.png[/img]
Hello everyone,

We are glad to release patch 1.0.5. Below are the new, updated contents, as well as some critical bug fixes:
New content:
[list]
[*] New evolved weapons: Protector Shield E1, Protector Shield E2, Spectral Dagger E1, Storm Amulet E2.
[*] 2 new traps as environment hazards for level 3.
[/list]

Updated content:
[list]
[*] Shrines are now spawned in level 3 with their new models that fit level 3 better.
[*] The boss at minute 15 will drop a good chest instead of a relic.
[*] Add a confirmation box when players click on the Exit button.
[/list]

Bug fixes:
[list]
[*] Fix the issue where players press Space right when leveled up which causes unwanted rewards.
[*] Fix an error with level 3 which allows players to walk out of the map, hopefully, that would fix the problem of the boss getting pushed out of the map as well.
[/list]

Thank you very much for your patience and your continued support as our team keeps on working to improve the game! If there is any issue, please let us know through forums or Discord!

Best,
FTS  team

notes.title: Early Access Patch 1.0.4 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42289403/f0f8d695335e36008f5ce308c4403b3314ef7b51.png[/img]
Hello gamers,

We are glad to publish level 3 of the game in this update. To unlock level 3, simply win level 2 with any existing characters. Note that due to time constraints, we still have more content to add to level 3, so please look forward to it in a future update!

Also included in this update are several bug fixes and improvements:
[list]
[*] Support 16:10 resolution.
[*] Magical Amory (Blessed Hammer Evolution 2) balancing: now the weapon will do more throwing damage the longer it is held before being thrown. After the weapon reaches its maximum holding duration, it will automatically throw.
[*] Fix the issue where music is not played when there are too many sound effects.
[/list]

notes.title: [Important/Please Read] Sexy Mystic Survivors Release FAQs
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42289403/f0f8d695335e36008f5ce308c4403b3314ef7b51.png[/img]
[b]I have Beautiful Mystic Survivors (BMS), how do I upgrade to Sexy Mystic Survivors (SMS)?[/b]
We will put on a bundle of BMS + SMS on release day at a big discount https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/29108/BMS_Upgrade_to_SMS/. And if you already have BMS, the price of BMS will be deducted from the bundle price. Essentially, it means you can purchase SMS at a big discount if you already have BMS.

If you are from a country where purchasing SMS on Steam is not an option, you can go to our Discord server for more help: https://discord.gg/NgtacRPTfy

[b]Will my BMS progress be transferred over to SMS?[/b]
Yes.

[b]Why not release the adult content as a DLC for BMS but a separate game (SMS)?[/b]
Due to the laws and regulations of the country where our Archmage Games Studio is located in, we are unable to add adult content DLC to BMS. SMS is actually released under Fantasize Games Studio, a studio located in USA.

[b]Why the adult content is not released as a free DLC? Why are you selling adult content (SMS) so expensively?[/b]
This game takes us many months and a lot of money to develop. The base game (BMS) is actually priced low taken into account that it doesn't have any adult content. Considering the prices of other high-quality adult games on the market, we believe the price of SMS is set appropriately.

[b]I already bought BMS and now I have to buy SMS too. Was I tricked into buying the same product twice?[/b]
Both SMS steam page and BMS steam page was made 8 months ago. And we never had the intention of releasing the adult content as a DLC for BMS. We have always made it clear that they will be separate games. And if you buy this bundle https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/29108/BMS_Upgrade_to_SMS/ , you will get SMS at a remarkably discounted price because the price of BMS will be subtracted from the bundle.

[b]The total amount of money I spent on buying BMS in the past and the bundle now is actually more than just buying SMS now. Is this intended?[/b]
We didn't intend for this to happen but our math sucks and it did happen. For this, we sincerely apologize to BMS owners. But please also keep in mind that BMS owners get to play the game 1 month before SMS owners.

[b]What is the adult content included in this release?[/b]
There are a total of 10 sex scenes in this release. And only the 5 female protagonists of the game have sex scenes:
[list]
[*] Bellatrix
[*] Melisandre
[*] Camyla
[*] Ayane
[*] Sophia
[/list]

Apart from the sex scenes, the portraits of the above 5 girls (and only of the above 5 girls) will get their clothes broken until their nipples are revealed.

[b]Why don't the other girls have adult content too?[/b]
The other 4 girls (Rosaline, Cassandra, Isaya, Ciara) belong to another future project of ours called "Eldencia". They are just guest characters in the game.

Apart from these 4 guest characters, we also have a plan to add more guest characters from other games into our game (as a collaboration with other developers), and these guest characters will not have sex scenes as well.

[b]What is the adult content planned for future updates?[/b]
We have 1 more big sex scene currently being worked on, and we will also add 100% nude portraits for the above 5 girls.

We may also add more sex scenes for the above 5 girls, or create original characters and add their sex scenes as well, but to be honest with you guys, that will largely depend on the performance of this release. So if you want to see more future content, please shower us with your support!
